text:
ana: dropping a quick UX thread  proposal: add a compare-overlay mode for heatmaps (toggle next to timepicker). overlay shows second cohort with adjustable opacity + a small "confidence" strip that indicates sampled/low-volume areas. goal: let teams visually diff p95 without spinning up full reports

mike: like it. two asks: 1) collapse overlay by default on small viewports, 2) keyboard shortcut to toggle compare (thinking `y`) :keyboard:

sara: a11y first: overlay updates must announce via aria-live (e.g., "Compare enabled: v2 p95 +24ms"). color alone won't do  add pattern fills or an icon and include accessible labels for deltas and confidence ticks

lex: micro-interaction: hovering synced buckets should show side-by-side micro-tooltips with volume, p95, and a small "Sampled" badge when applicable. allow pinning a bucket with `p` to compare across ranges

kevin: infra note: keep overlay samples client-side and cap to 5 buckets for preview. debounce hover at 250ms. feature-flag behind `compare_overlay` and telemetry: `compare_opened`, `overlay_pin`

jamie: copy tweak: label toggle "Compare cohorts" and tooltip header "p95 (cohort A vs B)". for sampled buckets use "p95 (est., n=12)" not just "estimated"

dev-bot: preview build: https://staging-console.redwood-inference.com/compare-overlay (expires in 72h) :rocket:

ana: I'll update Figma with overlay states, keyboard flow, and acceptance checklist: 1) aria-live summary, 2) color+pattern for overlays, 3) debounce + cap, 4) feature flag + telemetry. mocks later today :thumbsup:
